hook.text: pov: the group ride was supposed to be chill

text.text: me holding on for dear life

post.caption: nobody ever means it when they say chill. 360 cam under the bars so you can see me hanging on
post.altText: 360 camera view from a bike in a group ride on a tree-lined park road, riders passing on both sides, then the camera swings back to the rider pedalling.
